reviews.review_description: Really enjoying this game so far! The drills are fantastic, and it’s a great workout. I highly recommend picking it up, especially since it's a new release and has a lot of promise. There's plenty of room to grow, and I hope the developer keeps adding more content. I did notice a couple of areas for improvement: sometimes it doesn't seem to register all of my punches, and it would be awesome to have an option for less time between some of the combos to keep the intensity up. Overall, it's an awesome foundation—keep up the good work!

developer_response.body: Thanks for the feedback! I'll go ahead and add a setting to adjust the combo interval to the roadmap for the next update. Stay tuned!
